services.title: Physiotherapy
services.lede: We don't treat a list of medical conditions. We treat people with aches, pains, injuries and movement problems.
body: Assessment comes first: we work out what is actually wrong and what caused it, then tell you plainly. Care centres on hands-on manual treatment combined with rehabilitation through exercise.
The goal is to get you back to work, back to your sport, or simply out of pain — and to leave you able to manage the problem yourself.
points: Self-referral welcome — no GP letter needed
Referrals accepted from GPs and consultants

services.title: Tendon Clinic
services.lede: A dedicated programme for tendon problems, built on best-practice guidelines.
body: Tendon problems behave differently from other soft-tissue injuries, and they rarely respond to rest alone. The clinic combines activity modification with a graded, structured exercise programme, and uses shockwave therapy where it is indicated.
Tendinopathies are slow to settle. The programme is designed around that reality rather than against it.

services.title: Shockwave Therapy
services.lede: Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy (ESWT) for chronic and persistent soft-tissue injuries.
body: Shockwave is delivered non-invasively with a handheld probe. It is used to aid healing and to reduce pain, so that loading the tissue through exercise becomes tolerable — the exercise is what produces the lasting change.

Each session takes 20 to 30 minutes and includes assessment, treatment, aftercare advice and exercise prescription. Patients are asked to book a package of three consecutive weekly sessions; treatment often takes three or more.
treats: Shoulder pain, including calcific rotator cuff tendinopathy
points: Booked as three consecutive weekly sessions
Non-invasive, delivered with a handheld probe

services.title: Sports Physiotherapy
services.lede: For athletes from club level to international level.
body: We cover pre-season screening, diagnosis and management of injury, and corrective exercise programmes designed around the demands of your sport.
A full biomechanical screening may include running video analysis, muscle imbalance testing and assessment of foot alignment, with orthotics prescribed where they are needed.
points: Foot alignment assessment and orthotic prescription
services.price: A reduced rate may be available to sports clubs — ask reception.

services.title: Pilates Classes
services.lede: Classes run by specialist physiotherapists, aimed at control, posture and core stability.
body: The purpose is practical: better muscle control and posture reduce uneven wear on tissues and help stop an injury recurring. For many patients Pilates is the third stage of treatment rather than a separate activity.
If you are a CityPhysio patient, you complete a Pilates assessment form with your physiotherapist first. If you are not, arrive ten minutes early for a brief screening with the instructor.
points: Assessment or screening before your first class
services.booking: Class times change. Book through the online booking system — choose Lucan Clinic, then Group Sessions — or ask reception.

services.title: Women's Health
body: These problems are common. That does not make them normal, and it does not mean you have to live with them — they are treatable.
Assessment and treatment are private, and you can refer yourself.
treats: Pain or reduced sensation during intercourse

services.title: Acupuncture and Dry Needling
services.lede: Two distinct needle techniques, used for different purposes.
body: Dry needling uses a solid filament needle to treat myofascial trigger points and the pain and dysfunction associated with them. It is used alongside physiotherapy treatment.
Acupuncture, described in terms of traditional Chinese medicine, is also offered at the clinic, and is used to complement physiotherapy by relieving pain.

services.title: Corporate and On-site Services
services.lede: On-site physiotherapy and ergonomics for employers. We have been doing this for 15 years.
body: We work on site, which means problems get caught early and staff do not lose a half-day travelling to an appointment.
Programmes are built around the actual work being done rather than a generic template.
points: Physiotherapy management of pain and injury
Group programmes: backcare, postural correction, stretching, and work-related strength and conditioning

services.title: Hospital Services
services.lede: Physiotherapy provided in a number of private hospitals on a flexible basis.
body: We also provide medico-legal report assessments, and a consultant service to other physiotherapists.
